snapshot.premise_boundary: The seed B3 property is supplied, not checked. Sum rows are production data, not a uniqueness verification.
snapshot.witness_order: First encountered: triple rows lexicographic, then one-new pairs lexicographic before two-new single indices.
snapshot.family_boundary: Each allowed value is an independent one-element append to the same seed; allowed values are not mutually certified.

execution.scope: One new sum-row and obstruction construction; observed time only, not benchmark. No prior B3, field, cycle, orbit or decoder replay.

result.scope: This one appended value only; no simultaneous extension by other allowed values.

reader.scope: One independent fresh saved-index open. No pair/triple formation or candidate replay. Snapshot arithmetic/provenance not independently authenticated.
